[[Mallyx's Reaver]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] is defeated in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing Dmg]] 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Stygian Reaver]], [[dye]]d white.
